quote: Commitment is the foundation to all sustained relationships. A commitment is not the contract itself; it is what powers the contract.
author: Rev. Randy Lewis
linkName: Essay “The 5 C’s to a Great Relationship” — Sep 2015

True commitment nurtures the bonds we share, transforming mere contracts into lasting connections. Let us cherish and cultivate these relationships with integrity and love.
